chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Chick Webb band members and Danny Boy
summary: Mrs. H names Sandy Williams, Elmer Williams and Ella Fitzgerald and says Webb featured him on Danny Boy.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah, there was Sandy Williams. Did Sandy play with Chick? Walter Johnson on the drums. No, not Walter Johnson - Chick was on his own drums then. Ella Fitzgerald singing. I can't remember. What's his name - Elmer Williams - he's dead. He played saxophone. Who else do I remember in that band?
They don't know. These are young people you're talking to.
Do you remember any of the compositions and tunes -
I think Jay used to play - they used to feature him on - what's that Irish song?
No. It's a popular song. I can't think of it just now.
The song you used to play with Chick Webb - the song?
Oh, I know who you're talking about.
I'm talking about the song, not a person. I'm talking about you used to play the song, 'Danny Boy.'
Oh yeah, I played the song.
Chick Webb used to feature you on it, 'Danny Boy.'
